defects: Fixes the localization target to the single concrete construction `Localization S M` instead of gold's arbitrary `N` satisfying `IsLocalization S N` — this is a strictly narrower claim (one model) rather than gold's fully general statement (any localization of M at S).

Weakens/changes the base hypothesis on M from `CommSemiring` to `CommMonoidWithZero`, dropping the semiring/additive structure; this makes `Localization S M` refer to the purely multiplicative (monoid) localization rather than the semiring localization used by gold's `IsLocalization`/`Algebra` framework — not merely a notational variant of the same structure.
Omits the `Algebra M N` and `[CommSemiring N]` data entirely, since no separate localization codomain N is quantified over.

Does not supply a `[CancelCommMonoidWithZero M]`-level hypothesis, which is required for `UniqueFactorizationMonoid` to apply to a mere `CommMonoidWithZero` M (and likewise for the conclusion on `Localization S M`).
